title: The Captain's Ledger
summary: Osric Hale, Warden-Captain of the Watch at Thornwick's well, pays a bounty on the bright-eyed ones: the elite dead who lead the rest. He pays out of his own purse when Lord Pellam's coin is late, and writes every one down.

steps.journal: Defeat three elites in the Old Barrows: the bright-eyed ones that come to lead every fifth wave. Hold a room long enough and one comes to you.

objectives.label: Elites defeated in the Old Barrows

ready: Go back to Osric Hale at the Watch post by the well in Thornwick.
done: Osric Hale paid for three bright-eyed ones from the Old Barrows, and wrote three more lines in his ledger.
